summary: Backend regression for /api/menu/{store} override fix (server.py:686-732). 8/8 pytest cases passed against public URL. Verified: (1) PUT price on default MENU_DATA id=53 (Capuccino) 9→10 reflects immediately in BOTH /api/menu/runner and /api/menu/gym-londres; (2) PUT description+category also propagates; (3) restore to original 9.00 works; (4) POST custom TEST_ProdutoNovo appears in both public menus with price 5.50 and category 'Doces'; (5) PUT on custom item (5.50→7.25) reflects in both stores; (6) DELETE custom removes from both stores; (7) public payload keeps items, categories, adicionais, milk_options (4), store metadata and prep_time on defaults; (8) cleanup verifies zero TEST_ residuals and default price/category restored to 9.00 / 'Bebidas Quentes'. Confirmed live via curl on charts-3.preview.emergentagent.com after run.
critical_code_review_comments: MenuItemCreate REQUIRES 'store' field but POST /gestor/menu ignores it and always creates in both stores. Either remove the field or honor it — currently confusing (a request without 'store' returns 422 even though semantics don't need it).

server.py get_menu override loop (line 719) uses `if field in override and override[field] not in (None, '')`. If a gestor legitimately wants to set price=0 or available=False, current logic will drop those updates for `price` (float 0 is truthy for the check but 0.0 is not in (None,'') so ok) — but explicitly `available=False` will pass the `not in (None,'')` filter since False is not in that set. Confirmed OK. Just document behavior.

Override lookup priority is by-id first then by-normalized-name. If a custom doc has a name matching a MENU_DATA default but stored with different id AND a legitimate different id-based override also exists, only id override applies. This is the desired behavior but worth a comment in code.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ProdutoNovo and TEST_ToDelete created transiently via POST /api/gestor/menu; both deleted in-test and re-checked at end. Default id=53 (Capuccino) price/description/category restored to 9.00 / 'Bebida cremosa com espuma de leite' / 'Bebidas Quentes'.
